description: GUI Windows service manager with searchable inventory, previewed changes, service history, and configuration-drift snapshots.
notes: This manifest installs the official self-contained x64 GUI ZIP; it does not run the vendor MSI installer. The archive is extracted from its BetterWindowsServices folder.
The launcher redirects APPDATA to the persisted data\Roaming folder, keeping bws-preferences.json in Scoop's persistent data directory across updates.

For unelevated launches, the launcher sets DOTNET_BUNDLE_EXTRACT_BASE_DIR to the persisted data\dotnet folder instead of Windows TEMP. When elevated, the application's startup security check relaunches it with native libraries extracted under its ACL-protected %ProgramData%\BetterWindowsServices directory before WPF starts.
Windows 10 version 1809 or Windows Server 2019 and later, x64. Reading and reviewing service information does not require elevation; applying service changes requires an elevated session.
